summary: Tested both backend and frontend for Vendor ageing, Users & Roles editor, OpenAPI client integration safety, inbound GRN flows, and nav rewiring. Requested module flows passed end-to-end. Auth playbook checks found security/config deviations (no app auth cookie, permissive CORS without credentials, bcrypt format mismatch, and no seed_admin command).

critical.issue: Login response does not set an application auth httpOnly cookie; only Cloudflare __cf_bm cookie observed. Playbook expected cookie-backed auth behavior check.
Preflight returns access-control-allow-origin='*' and no access-control-allow-credentials. Playbook expects explicit origin + credentials support when credentialed auth is used.

minor.issue: No seed_admin command found; project uses seed_foundation upsert instead. If playbook strictly requires seed_admin semantics, this is a gap to reconcile/document.
Owner password hash is pbkdf2_sha256..., not $2b$ bcrypt prefix expected by provided playbook check.

action_items: Decide and implement auth strategy alignment with playbook: either add secure httpOnly cookie auth flow (and credentials CORS) or explicitly update playbook/acceptance criteria to token-in-body pattern.
If bcrypt is mandatory by policy, configure PASSWORD_HASHERS and reseed/reset credentials safely; otherwise document PBKDF2 as accepted standard.
If seed_admin behavior is required, add/alias command with idempotent update semantics and test coverage.
Optional: keep current RBAC/inbound tests as regression baseline and run in CI.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested product flows are implemented correctly and integrated: /ledgers/vendor ageing cards+table, /masters/users and /edges/rbac editor with owner/admin gating, /inbound list/new/detail, and nav wiring to /inbound.
Generated OpenAPI schema/client exists and app still authenticates and loads core pages; typedApi usage in MasterPages is functioning.
RBAC UI creation flow can be timing-sensitive right after role save (role dropdown option appears after refresh); this was a test-timing issue, not a product failure.
Auth/security checks from playbook currently do not match implementation posture (token JSON flow + permissive CORS).

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 pytest passed for this iteration scope)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested UI/integration flows passed in browser automation)

test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used: owner/Owner@123, admin/Admin@123, deo.cashier/Store@123, accounts1/Acct@123.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary UI/API test records and cleaned up: UI Auto Role + UI Auto User were deactivated in UI cleanup; backend fixture-created TEST role/user also deactivated in teardown. Created direct GRN test records remain as append-only business data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested feature set is passing. Focus next run on auth-policy reconciliation (cookie/CORS/hash/seed_admin expectations) and rerun auth playbook validations after fixes. Existing regression test file for this scope is ready at backend/tests/test_iteration9_rbac_vendor_inbound.py.
rca of the issue: Auth deviations are configuration/architecture mismatch rather than runtime breakage: frontend/backend currently use JWT in response body + Authorization header. Therefore no app auth cookie is set, CORS credentials headers are absent, and password hashing uses Django default PBKDF2. Repro: POST /api/auth/login (owner creds) and inspect response headers; OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin and request headers shows ACAO='*' and no ACAC. Mitigation: either implement cookie-based auth + strict CORS credentials or formalize current bearer-token architecture in security playbook and acceptance checks.
